test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - Quant (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A solid hemisphere of radius R is sliced horizontally at 1/3 rd of its height from the base. Find the volume of the smaller (top) segment.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Height of hemisphere = Radius = R.

Slice height from base = R/3 ⇒ Height of top segment (h) = R − R/3 = 2R/3.

Volume of spherical cap = (πh²/3)(3R − h).

Substituting h = 2R/3: V = (π(2R/3)²/3)(3R − 2R/3) = (4πR²/27) × (7R/3) = 28πR³/81.

**∴ The correct answer is 28πR3/81. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of solid hemisphere = R

Height of slice from base = R/3

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a spherical segment (cap) of height h from a sphere of radius R is given by:

V = πh²(R − h/3)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb037c47e7445a097ab950c5d3d0646832c940f2cdad6a5d9e4abe56e03f25f7.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total height of the hemisphere = R

⇒ Height of the slice from the base = R/3

⇒ Height of the top segment (spherical cap), h = R − R/3 = 2R/3

⇒ Volume of the top segment = π × (2R/3)² × [R − (2R/3)/3]

⇒ Volume = π × (4R²/9) × [R − 2R/9]

⇒ Volume = π × (4R²/9) × (7R/9)

⇒ Volume = 28πR³/81

**∴ **The correct answer is 28πR3/81**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Hemisphere

The total volume of a solid hemisphere of radius R is V = 2/3 πR³.

Spherical Cap Volume

The volume of a spherical cap can also be expressed using the radius of its base (a) and height (h) as V = πh/6 × (3a² + h²).

Surface Area of Hemisphere

The curved surface area is 2πR² and the total surface area (including the base) is 3πR².
